title: DNA Extraction Protocol from Frozen Filtration Capsules
author: Camilla Capelli
materials: Different equipment can be used to quantify the total amount of DNA extracted (e.g. Qubit ®Fluorometer system, Nanodrop)

steps.title: Prepare workspace and protective equipment
steps.instruction: Wear gloves at all times; clean the bench with DNA‑off solution or 10 % commercial bleach before and after manipulation; use filtered tips; perform all steps in a DNA‑work station (sterile area with air filtration and UV); if possible work in a room for rare/degraded DNA (positive air pressure, UV treatment, frequent air renewal, full protective clothing and mask) – otherwise a room where PCR products are amplified is acceptable.

steps.title: Add mild lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL mild lysis buffer to each frozen filtration capsule and store for 2 h at 4 °C; agitate the capsule for 15 min on a flask shaker at 800 rpm.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation and cold storage
steps.instruction: Collect 30 mL of buffer from each capsule and split equally into two 50 mL tubes (15 mL each); add 33 mL absolute ethanol and 1.5 mL 3 M sodium acetate to each tube; store the tubes at least one night at –20 °C; centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 15 min at 6 °C; discard supernatant, resuspend each pellet and merge the two resuspended pellets into one tube.

steps.title: Add ATL buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 720 µL ATL buffer (Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) to the merged pellet, vortex at full speed for 5 min, then transfer the mixture to a 2 mL tube containing 20 µL Proteinase K Mix; incubate 2 h at 56 °C; centrifuge 2 min at 11,000 × g at 4 °C; transfer the clear supernatant to a new 2 mL tube, add 150 µL buffer SL3, vortex 5 s, incubate 5 min at 0‑4 °C, and centrifuge 1 min at 11,000 × g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Filter lysate through inhibitor removal column
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Inhibitor Removal Column (red ring) onto a 2 mL collection tube (with lid); load up to 650 µL of the clear supernatant and centrifuge 1 min at 11,000 × g; repeat loading and centrifugation until all supernatant is filtered, collecting the filtrate in clean tubes; discard the column. If a pellet appears after centrifugation, transfer the clear supernatant to a new collection tube before continuing.

steps.title: Adjust binding conditions
steps.instruction: Pool all filtered lysate in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 250 µL SB Buffer, close the lid and vortex 5 s.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica column
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Soil Column (green ring) into a 2 mL collection tube; load 550 µL of the sample onto the column and centrifuge 1 min at 11,000 × g; discard the flow‑through and return the column to the tube; load the remaining sample, centrifuge 1 min at 11,000 × g; discard the flow‑through and keep the column in the tube.

steps.title: Wash and dry silica membrane
steps.instruction:
Perform four washes using the same collection tube:
1️⃣ Add 500 µL Buffer SB, centrifuge 30 s at 11,000 × g, discard flow‑through.
2️⃣ Add 550 µL Buffer SW1, centrifuge 30 s at 11,000 × g, discard flow‑through.
3️⃣ Add 650 µL Buffer SW2, close lid, vortex 2 s, centrifuge 30 s at 11,000 × g, discard flow‑through.
4️⃣ Add 650 µL Buffer SW2, close lid, vortex 2 s, centrifuge 30 s at 11,000 × g, discard flow‑through.
Dry the silica membrane by centrifuging 2 min at 11,000 × g. If any liquid contacts the column after drying, discard the flow‑through and centrifuge again.

steps.title: Elute DNA and store
steps.instruction: Place the column into a new microcentrifuge tube (not supplied); add 50 µL Buffer SE pre‑heated to 37 °C, do not close the lid, incubate 1 min 30 s at room temperature (18‑25 °C), close the lid and centrifuge 30 s at 11,000 × g. Repeat the same elution with the same column and tube to obtain a total of 100 µL DNA. Discard the column, keep the tube with 100 µL DNA, and store frozen at –20 °C (or –80 °C for long‑term storage).
